title: Gate properties of fan-in-two circuits
statement: Let $C$ be a finite directed acyclic circuit. Suppose every gate of $C$ has pairwise distinct input vertices, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and every gate has at most two inputs. Then each gate has pairwise distinct inputs, a NOT gate has exactly one input, and the gate has at most two inputs.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate's input list has no repetitions
Every NOT gate has exactly one input
Every gate has at most two inputs
